text:
Carmen: Quick heads up  overnight onboarding imports partially failed for ~9 tenants; 2 are in a renewal window in 6 days. Need a short, empathetic note + concrete mitigation to send within 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident onboarding-imports: detected 2026-08-03T02:10Z, partial mitigation 2026-08-03T04:30Z.

Diego: Sending DM with tenant list now (will pull traces).

Carmen: DM list: EmberBooks (acct_ember), HarborHealth (acct_harbor) are the renewal-risk ones. Others mostly CSV/JSON batch imports. Failures 02:05-02:28 UTC.

Mari: Ops quick RCA: q-onboard circuit-breaker triggered by delayed S3 acknowledgements during nightly compaction. We extended timeouts, drained the queue, and replayed messages. No object loss; a subset needed manual replay. Full RCA draft coming after legal review.

Priya: For the two renewal-risk tenants I propose: choose either a 30% one-time invoice credit OR a 14-day trial extension, plus 2h dedicated enablement and priority manual replay + verification. Also offer a private SE office hour.

Ben: SE can run manual replays. Runbook snippet:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/replays -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"acct_ember","mode":"manual"}'
```Will attach preview link and index delta after run.

Carmen: Draft outbound for priority tenants (short):

```
Hi <Customer name>,

Were sorry  on Aug 03 UTC a partial onboarding import for your account was delayed. Our team resolved the issue by Aug 03 04:30 UTC and prioritized a manual replay for affected customers.

What were doing for you:
- Priority manual replay and verification (well share a preview link once complete)
- Make-good: choose either a 30% one-time credit on your next invoice OR a 14-day trial extension
- Enablement: 2 hours of dedicated setup help + invitation to a private SE office hour

If youd like an immediate manual replay, reply and well prioritize your tenant.

Thanks,
Carmen on behalf of Redwood Customer Success
```

Diego: LGTM. Add billing line: "credit applied to the first invoice after the incident" and a short verification step (Console > Docs preview + index count).

Priya: Ill send the two personalized emails now and batch the remaining tenants in an automated note tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Ill log outreach and capture feedback via the incident tracker.

SE-bot: Replay for acct_ember started 2026-08-03T05:05Z, completed 2026-08-03T05:10Z. Index delta +1,142. Preview: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/acct_ember/preview

Carmen: Great  send EmberBooks + HarborHealth now with the credit/trial option and preview link. Mark renewal owners in Gainsight and tag "priority outreach".

Priya: Sent both, logged in tracker, pinged renewal owners. Batch scheduled for tomorrow.

Mari: Ops will publish the RCA URL to status.redwood.ai after legal review.

Carmen: Closing thread  update tracker with any replies and capture NPS 7 days after recovery. Thanks team. (reactions: :white_check_mark:)
